title: Driver profile naming and name correction
summary: This topic centers on driver profile names, vehicle naming, and references to assistant wake-name behavior, with most examples too fragmentary to assign a clear evaluative sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review appreciates the ability to name vehicles separately while noting both cars currently share one profile and wake-up command.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a customer name, name correction support, seeing a name and photo in the vehicle, and an assistant interrupting unexpectedly, but the fragments do not provide enough context for firm sentiment classification.

limitations: The sample is very small and mostly undetermined, so concrete takeaways are limited.
The topic clusters two loosely related subjects—driver profile naming/name correction and assistant wake-name behavior—so the examples do not form a fully coherent single issue.
Several fragments are service-note style statements with insufficient context to determine customer sentiment.
